verdict.rationale: A live probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://docs.openhands.dev/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so the spec is directly downloadable. The docs also describe an HTTP/WebSocket Agent Server API and list API support for automation and scripting, which supports the spec being an actual product API rather than a docs artifact. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing which API the spec covers and how it is versioned, and confirmation that the spec fully matches the Agent Server/Cloud API surface.
